io.milvus.pool

Class MilvusClientV2Pool

  • java.lang.Object
    • io.milvus.pool.ClientPool<ConnectConfig,MilvusClientV2>
      • io.milvus.pool.MilvusClientV2Pool

  • public class MilvusClientV2Pool
extends ClientPool<ConnectConfig,MilvusClientV2>
    Pool of v2 MilvusClientV2 instances created from a ConnectConfig config.

    Clients are created via the MilvusClientV2 constructor and managed by the underlying ClientPool. Use getClient/returnClient to borrow and return clients keyed by endpoint.
